description: This file defines the MacNodeBrowserProxy actor class that acts as a proxy to interact with a local Mac node, handling HTTP requests, encoding/decoding JSON payloads, and managing file proxies. It includes methods for making network requests, parsing responses, and loading proxy files.

classes.name: MacNodeBrowserProxy
classes.description: An actor class providing asynchronous methods to communicate with a local Mac node proxy, handle requests, and process proxy files.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request with JSON parameters to the Mac node proxy and returns a JSON string response with loaded proxy files info.

methods.name: defaultEndpoint
methods.description: Provides default endpoint configuration for the proxy connection.

methods.name: decodeRequestParams
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into RequestParams struct.

methods.name: makeRequest
methods.description: Constructs a URLRequest from request parameters and endpoint data.

methods.name: requireHTTPResponse
methods.description: Validates that a URL response is an HTTPURLResponse.

methods.name: httpErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message for HTTP error responses based on response data.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Converts various data types into their string representations.

methods.name: loadProxyFiles
methods.description: Loads and encodes proxy files from response payload.

methods.name: collectProxyPaths
methods.description: Recursively collects proxy file paths from JSON payload.

methods.name: loadProxyFile
methods.description: Loads a file from disk, verifies it, and encodes its content into a ProxyFilePayload.
